price_references.note: Baseline is the first signal's own observation, known by its decision time. Use the first recorded attempt at/after signal+horizon within the frozen exit window. Policies with forward_quote_window_version=2 skip only quotes demonstrably fetched before that window; actual post-window failures are never replaced with later winners. Legacy policies retain first-record selection. Declared live capture metadata is not independent API verification. Price changes ignore costs and cannot establish executable entry/exit, profit, interval extrema or global missed opportunities. Missing/rejected candidates remain counted; original paper policies and outcomes are unchanged.

forward_evaluation.note: Separate prospectively declared protocol, not reassignment of legacy tests. Missing and rejected candidates remain counted; selected and comparison control are disjoint. No threshold fitting or profitability conclusion.

limitations: Partial discovery feeds; global missed opportunities cannot be measured.
Missing, rejected and unavailable results stay in their denominator; PnL is unknown.
Candidates without first evaluations remain counted, without invented experiments.
Later alerts do not retrospectively select a first evaluation. Selected and control groups can overlap.
Independent simulations are not one capital-constrained portfolio; no portfolio drawdown is inferred.
Wilson intervals assume independent outcomes; correlated tokens and unequal coverage limit comparisons.
Thresholds are not optimized on this report; unassigned data are not a holdout.
Nonprofitable means net paper PnL <= 0 among evaluated results, not a verified false factual claim. Sensitivity bounds assume all unknown outcomes fail/succeed; they are not predictions.
